name: South Mountain YMCA Day Camps
operator_name: South Mountain YMCA (Metropolitan YMCA of the Oranges)
description_short: YMCA day camps around Maplewood for pre-K to grade 10: YKnots for 3 year olds to kindergarten at the Y, SOMAPY traditional camp at Memorial Park with swim days at the Maplewood Country Club, Summer Discovery STEM camp at St. Joseph Church, plus teen, theater and sports options.
notes: Weekly price is the community (non-member) rate for SOMAPY; Summer Discovery is $649 and YKnots $651.20 for community members. Y Member rates are $590 to $592 and Y Family Member rates $531 to $532.80 a week. Camp 7:30 am to 3:30 pm; aftercare 3:30 to 6 pm for a fee ($110 a week community, $100 members, posted on the YKnots page). SOMAPY at Memorial Park, 124 Dunnell Road (grades 1 to 5); Summer Discovery at St. Joseph Church, 240 Franklin Avenue (grades 1 to 5); YKnots at the Y (age 3 to kindergarten). 20 percent down payment; $35 change fee from February 1; April 1 is the last day for a deposit refund. 2027 registration opens December 1, 2026.
